title: This Fish Stays 20 Degrees Warmer Than the Freezing Sea
subject: Atlantic bluefin tuna

scenes.text: Almost every fish matches the temperature of the sea. This one refuses.
Atlantic bluefin tuna feed in water as cold as 2.8 degrees Celsius, close to freezing.
Yet their bodies stay around 25 degrees Celsius, warm enough to cross a continent's worth of ocean.
Tagged bluefin have crossed the Atlantic and dived below 1,000 meters.
A warm body powers strong muscles in cold water, and they can swim about 45 kilometers an hour.
A fish that runs hot in a freezing ocean. That is how it rules it.
